claims.quote: around one in six young people here are not in education, employment or training
claims.statement: Around one in six young people in Scotland are not in education, employment or training.

claims.quote: you’ll see around one in twenty shops lying empty
claims.statement: In Edinburgh around one in twenty shops are lying empty.

claims.quote: if you go to Dundee, it’s more likely one in five
claims.statement: In Dundee it is more likely that one in five shops are empty.

claims.quote: A man in East Renfrewshire can live, as I understand, on average seven years longer than a man in Glasgow
claims.statement: A man in East Renfrewshire can live on average around seven years longer than a man in Glasgow.

claims.quote: a defence sector that already supports 12,000 jobs here in Scotland
claims.statement: The defence sector already supports 12,000 jobs in Scotland.

claims.quote: Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is itself one of the most centralised nations in Europe.
claims.statement: Scotland, the most devolved nation in the UK, is one of the most centralised nations in Europe.

claims.quote: I want to offer Scotland a model of localised employment support
claims.statement: The UK government will offer Scotland a model of localised employment support, a DWP devolution offer.

claims.quote: I won’t have a country where we get comfortable with the idea of kids in their 20s just being there on benefits.
claims.statement: The Prime Minister will not accept a country where young people in their 20s are simply on benefits.

claims.quote: it would have hugely beneficial impacts on the food industry and farming here in Scotland
claims.statement: A new deal for food and farming with the EU would hugely benefit the food industry and farming in Scotland.

claims.quote: companies like Chemify turn groundbreaking research into real manufacturing jobs in Glasgow
claims.statement: Chemify is an example of a company turning groundbreaking research into real manufacturing jobs in Glasgow.

claims.quote: So in a couple of weeks, the National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales
claims.statement: The National Economic Council will meet with the First Ministers of Scotland and Wales in a couple of weeks to put the devolution offer on the table.

facts.quote: In August 2023, with the help of the ground-breaking Scottish Violence Reduction Unit, I visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse
facts.statement: The Prime Minister visited FARE-Scotland at Bannatyne House in Easterhouse in August 2023 with the Greater Manchester Violence Reduction Unit.

facts.quote: It is great that the Scottish government has this week agreed to match the UK government’s £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges
facts.statement: The Scottish government agreed this week to match the UK government's £10 million to create two defence technical excellence colleges.

facts.quote: I put buses back under public control
facts.statement: As Mayor of Greater Manchester, the Prime Minister put buses back under public control and chose Alexander Dennis in Falkirk to build the buses.

facts.quote: I was in Scotland for the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in the summer
facts.statement: The Prime Minister attended the Opening Ceremony of the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in the summer.

facts.quote: I am working on a new deal for food and farming at the EU-UK Summit on the 20th of November
facts.statement: The Prime Minister is working on a new deal for food and farming to be discussed at the EU-UK Summit on 20 November.

facts.quote: The review led by Alan Milburn is challenging us to look at this very differently.
facts.statement: A review led by Alan Milburn is underway on how to support people into work.

facts.quote: the Scottish government has also announced a long-term programme for local government reform
facts.statement: The Scottish government has announced a long-term programme for local government reform.
